plan.question: Do the half-minus-full backward-scale allocation effects, and their interaction with aligned versus crossed field products, persist across prospectively paired independent initializations under a verified common implementation? The seed42 full-population validation factorial gives AUC gains of approximately 0.0001204973 for aligned products and 0.0004667050 for crossed products, but aligned half worsens both AUC and Logloss for empty and 1-16-event histories. These observations support a bounded optimization contrast, not semantic mediation or repeated support. The historical magnitude maximum (AUC 0.6152795937) falls to 0.6149279139 on an exact-source replay; a later magnitude pair is positive and another negative. This makes robustness more consequential than another adaptive seed42 mechanism sweep. The latest inference shortcut preserves reported population and slice metrics at AUC 0.6151021885 and Logloss 0.1965325839; its one-pair timing improvement does not resolve this quality question. Retrieve the missing execution, provenance and resource evidence needed to decide whether a frozen original-reference plus four-cell replication suite is admissible. Mixed or nonpositive paired effects, reversed interaction, or invalid source/information isolation would weaken or invalidate the corresponding explanation. Independent seeds would not remove bias from prior adaptive validation reuse.

Verify common parameter construction, normalization/VJP rules, masks, floor guards, loss, initialization/data-order policy and checkpoint selection before attributing effects or reusing seed42 jobs. Half denotes inverse-norm scale reassignment, not multiplying the entire gradient by one half.

An authoritative updated ledger and complete preparation, attribution, repetition and closed-assessment tariffs. At resolution the remaining budget is 29616.4855 seconds; ten additional jobs would require an estimated 7043.7297 seconds or 17609.3243 seconds at summed per-trial caps, conditional on valid reuse of five seed42 jobs. These training-only quantities do not establish affordability. Reserve assessment and failure costs first; if the suite cannot fit, justify a smaller contrast and explicitly forgo repeated interaction claims.

No final suite is currently frozen. Do not request withheld outcomes during retrieval or use them to revise open research; retain them solely in the closed archive.
